reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. The new native sparse cellular automata (CA) keeps ponds affordable and allows for smoother terrain shaping without freezing the frame. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Improved Water Mechanics in Provincia!
